title: 🔥 Maya's laptop overheats... the cleaning mistake that cooks the fan #laptopfix #pctips
title_alts: 🧹 Maya cleans a laptop vent the safe way, start to finish #laptopfix #pctips
🚫 Maya's laptop fan dies from one long blast of canned air #laptopfix #pctips
description_hook: A laptop that roars and runs hot is almost always a blocked vent. Here is how to clear it without wrecking the fan.
setting: a home desk and a towel-covered work surface
protagonist_type: a home laptop owner doing her own maintenance

characters.name: Maya
characters.description: thirty-four, black hair tied back, grey hooded sweatshirt, a small screwdriver always in her shirt pocket

claims.basis: round illustrative warm-up period, stated as a rough check rather than a specification

claims.claim: Clean the vent every six months
claims.basis: round illustrative maintenance interval, stated as a habit not a specification

scenes.narration: Your laptop sounds like a hairdryer and runs hot.
scenes.caption: आपका लैपटॉप हेयर ड्रायर जैसा शोर करता है और गरम रहता है
scenes.image_brief: A slim silver laptop open on a cluttered wooden desk, a loose paper beside the side vent lifting in the escaping air, the desk surface next to the vent faintly hazy with heat, warm evening lamp light from the left.

scenes.narration: Dust packs the vent until hot air cannot leave.
scenes.caption: धूल वेंट बंद कर देती है, गरम हवा बाहर नहीं निकल पाती
scenes.image_brief: A very close view of a laptop's side exhaust vent matted over with a grey felt of dust, only thin dark gaps left between the slots, cool white light raking across the surface.

scenes.narration: So the fan spins faster. The chip then slows itself down.
scenes.caption: तो पंखा तेज़ घूमता है और चिप खुद अपनी रफ़्तार घटा लेती है
scenes.image_brief: The opened underside of a laptop showing a small black blower fan with dust-caked blades sitting beside two flattened copper heat pipes, plain bright overhead light, no hands in frame.

scenes.narration: You need a screwdriver, a can of compressed air, and a torch.
scenes.caption: एक पेचकस, कंप्रेस्ड ऐयर का कैन और एक टॉर्च चाहिए
scenes.image_brief: A small Phillips screwdriver, a can of compressed air with its red straw fitted, and a short metal torch laid in a neat row on a folded white towel, even soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Unplug the charger. Pull the battery if it lifts out.
scenes.caption: चार्जर निकालें। बैटरी निकल सकती हो तो वह भी निकालें
scenes.image_brief: A laptop lying face down on a folded towel with its charger unplugged and coiled to one side, a black battery pack lifted out and set beside it, soft daylight from a window.

scenes.narration: Find the intake grille underneath, usually near a corner.
scenes.caption: नीचे किसी कोने के पास हवा खींचने वाली जाली ढूँढें
scenes.image_brief: The clean grey underside of a laptop with a rectangular slotted intake grille near the front left corner, four rubber feet and a row of tiny screws visible, bright even light.

scenes.narration: Blow short bursts through it from outside, never one long blast.
scenes.caption: बाहर से छोटे-छोटे झोंके मारें, एक लंबी फूँक कभी नहीं
scenes.image_brief: A can of compressed air standing angled beside a laptop's underside grille with a small grey puff of dust escaping sideways from the slots, dust motes hanging in bright daylight, no hands in frame.

scenes.narration: Hold the fan blades still with a toothpick while you spray.
scenes.caption: स्प्रे करते समय टूथपिक से पंखे की ब्लेड रोके रखें
scenes.image_brief: A wooden toothpick wedged between the blades of a small laptop fan to stop it turning, grey dust still clinging to the blade edges, bright focused work light on the open chassis.

scenes.narration: Shine the torch in. You should see metal fins, not grey felt.
scenes.caption: टॉर्च डालकर देखें। धूसर रुई नहीं, धातु की परतें दिखनी चाहिए
scenes.image_brief: A torch beam passing through a laptop's cleared vent grille and lighting the thin metal fins behind it, no dust left on the slots, the surrounding room dark so the beam stands out.

scenes.narration: Run it for ten minutes. The fan should settle to a hum.
scenes.caption: दस मिनट चलाएँ। पंखे की आवाज़ धीमी गुनगुनाहट रह जाए
scenes.image_brief: A reassembled laptop open and running on a tidy desk with a small kitchen timer beside it set near ten minutes, a glass of water further back, calm daylight.

scenes.narration: Still loud after cleaning? The paste under the heatsink has dried out.
scenes.caption: सफ़ाई के बाद भी शोर? हीटसिंक के नीचे का पेस्ट सूख गया है
scenes.image_brief: An open laptop chassis with the copper heatsink still bolted down and a crust of cracked grey thermal paste squeezed out at its edge, cool overhead light.

scenes.narration: That needs the heatsink off, and a shop does it cheaply.
scenes.caption: उसके लिए हीटसिंक खोलना पड़ता है, दुकान पर सस्ते में होता है
scenes.image_brief: A repair bench with a laptop heatsink lifted off and laid on an anti static mat beside a small tube of thermal paste and a lint-free wipe, even bright workshop lighting.

scenes.narration: Clean the vent every six months and write it on a calendar.
scenes.caption: हर छह महीने वेंट साफ़ करें और कैलेंडर पर लिख लें
scenes.image_brief: A paper wall calendar pinned above a desk with one date circled and a handwritten note reading clean laptop vent, the closed laptop resting on the desk below, morning light.

title: 📶 Devan's laptop keeps losing Wi-Fi... the one setting nobody checks #wifi #laptopfix
title_alts: 🔌 Devan stops his laptop powering down its own Wi-Fi radio #wifi #laptopfix
🚫 Devan nearly bought a new router his laptop never needed #wifi #laptopfix
description_hook: Your phone holds the signal but the laptop drops it every few minutes. The radio is being switched off to save power.
problem_domain: wireless dropouts on a single computer
setting: a small flat with one router and several devices
protagonist_type: a remote worker with a flaky laptop

characters.name: Devan
characters.description: twenty-eight, short curly hair, faded green t-shirt, a coiled ethernet cable worn round one wrist

claims.basis: round illustrative test duration, stated as a rough check rather than a measurement

scenes.narration: Your phone shows full Wi-Fi. Your laptop keeps dropping out.
scenes.caption: फ़ोन में पूरा वाई-फ़ाई है, लैपटॉप का कनेक्शन टूटता रहता है
scenes.image_brief: A laptop open on a kitchen table showing a wireless icon with no bars, a phone face up beside it showing a full signal icon, bright morning light through a window behind them.

scenes.narration: Most laptops are allowed to power down the Wi-Fi radio.
scenes.caption: ज़्यादातर लैपटॉप वाई-फ़ाई रेडियो की बिजली बंद कर सकते हैं
scenes.image_brief: A close view of a small wireless card seated in an opened laptop with two thin black antenna wires clipped to it, its status light dark, cool even light on the bare circuit board.

scenes.narration: When it wakes back up late, the router has already given up.
scenes.caption: देर से जागने पर राउटर तब तक कनेक्शन छोड़ चुका होता है
scenes.image_brief: A white home router on a bookshelf with its wireless light blinking and an empty dust-free rectangle beside it where a laptop usually sits, dim evening light from a lamp below.

scenes.narration: Write your network name and password on paper before you start.
scenes.caption: शुरू करने से पहले नेटवर्क का नाम और पासवर्ड काग़ पर लिखें
scenes.image_brief: A small notepad on a desk with a network name and a password written out in blue ink, a pen lying across the page and the router's printed label card beside it, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Open the network adapter settings and find your wireless card.
scenes.caption: नेटवर्क अडैप्टर सेटिंग्स खोलें और अपना वायरलेस कार्ड ढूँढें
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen filled with a device list where a wireless network adapter entry is highlighted blue, a properties window opening over it, cool screen glow in a dim room.

scenes.narration: Turn off the setting that lets the computer power it down.
scenes.caption: वह सेटिंग बंद करें जो कंप्यूटर को बिजली काटने देती है
scenes.image_brief: A tight view of a power management tab on a laptop screen with a single checkbox left unticked beside the words allow the computer to turn off this device, cool screen light.

scenes.narration: Then forget the network. Join it again with the password.
scenes.caption: अब नेटवर्क भूल जाएँ। पासवर्ड डालकर फिर से जुड़ें
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing a list of saved wireless networks with a forget button under the highlighted one and an empty password box waiting below, the notepad visible at the edge of the desk, cool screen light.

scenes.narration: Stream a video for five minutes while you walk around the house.
scenes.caption: घर में घूमते हुए पाँच मिनट तक वीडियो चलाकर देखें
scenes.image_brief: A laptop balanced on a sofa arm playing a video, a long hallway and an open doorway visible beyond it, soft afternoon light coming through half-drawn curtains.

scenes.narration: No stutter? Good. The radio now stays awake.
scenes.caption: रुकावट नहीं? बढ़िया। अब रेडियो जागता रहता है
scenes.image_brief: A laptop resting on a made bed with a video playing smoothly and a full wireless icon in the corner of the screen, a warm bedside lamp lighting the room.

scenes.narration: If every device in the house drops, blame the router instead.
scenes.caption: अगर घर का हर डिवाइस टूटता है तो दोष राउटर का है
scenes.image_brief: A living room side table holding a router, with a tablet, a phone and a laptop arranged around it and each screen showing a warning triangle over its wireless icon, flat grey daylight.

scenes.narration: A rented box with a dead antenna is a swap, not a fix.
scenes.caption: मरे हुए एंटीना वाला किराए का बॉक्स बदलना पड़ता है
scenes.image_brief: A scuffed old router on a windowsill with one external antenna snapped at the hinge and hanging down, a dusty coiled cable behind it, harsh midday light through the glass.

scenes.narration: Test it once from the furthest room, then write down the result.
scenes.caption: सबसे दूर के कमरे से एक बार जाँचें और नतीजा लिख लें
scenes.image_brief: A laptop open on a desk in the furthest bedroom of a flat with a stopwatch and an open notebook beside it, the bedroom door standing open onto a long hallway, soft daylight.

title: 😰 Priya's PC will not turn on... dead, or just a dark screen? #pcrepair #pctips
title_alts: 🔌 Priya's ten second power drain wakes a dead desktop tower #pcrepair #pctips
🚫 Priya almost replaced a PC that only lost its video input #pcrepair #pctips
description_hook: A machine with no power and a machine with no picture look identical from the chair. Two minutes of checks tell them apart.
problem_domain: a desktop that appears completely dead
setting: a home office with a tower under the desk

characters.name: Priya
characters.description: forty-one, shoulder-length brown hair, navy cardigan with rolled sleeves, reading glasses pushed up on her head

claims.claim: Hold the power button down for ten seconds
claims.basis: round illustrative hold time, stated as a rough instruction rather than a specification

scenes.narration: You press the power button. Nothing happens at all.
scenes.caption: आपने पावर बटन दबाया। कुछ भी नहीं हुआ
scenes.image_brief: A beige-grey desktop tower standing under a desk with its power button unlit, a dark monitor above it and an untouched keyboard in front, cold early morning light from a nearby window.

scenes.narration: A dead machine and a dark screen are two different faults.
scenes.caption: मरी हुई मशीन और काली स्क्रीन दो अलग खराबियाँ हैं
scenes.image_brief: Two desktop towers side by side on a workbench, one with every light off and one with a glowing blue power light beside a completely black monitor, even neutral light.

scenes.narration: One means no electricity. The other means the picture never arrives.
scenes.caption: एक का मतलब बिजली नहीं। दूसरे का मतलब तस्वीर नहीं आ रही
scenes.image_brief: A wall socket with a computer power lead pushed firmly in, and on the floor beside it a video cable lying unplugged with its connector exposed, plain daylight on the skirting board.

scenes.narration: Fetch a spare power lead, and pick a different wall socket to try.
scenes.caption: एक अतिरिक्त पावर केबल लाएँ और दूसरा सॉकेट आज़माने के लिए चुनें
scenes.image_brief: A spare black kettle-style power lead coiled on a desk next to a small torch, with a free double wall socket visible on the wall behind, warm afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Swap the power lead first, then move to the other socket.
scenes.caption: पहले पावर केबल बदलें, फिर दूसरे सॉकेट पर जाएँ
scenes.image_brief: The rear panel of a desktop tower with the old power lead pulled out and lying loose on the floor and a new lead ready beside the inlet, bright work light.

scenes.narration: Hold the power button down for ten seconds to drain it.
scenes.caption: पावर बटन दस सेकंड दबाकर रखें, जमा चार्ज निकल जागा
scenes.image_brief: A close view of a desktop tower's dark front panel with the round power button pressed inward and the small drive light beside it unlit, a torch beam picking the panel out of the under-desk shadow.

scenes.narration: Now listen closely. Any fan, any click, any single light?
scenes.caption: अब ध्यान से सुनें। कोई पंखा, कोई क्लिक, कोई बत्ती?
scenes.image_brief: The open side of a quiet desktop tower showing a motionless case fan, an unlit motherboard and one tiny green light glowing at the board's edge, dark surroundings.

scenes.narration: A lit button with a black screen means the monitor input is wrong.
scenes.caption: बटन जल रहा है पर स्क्रीन काली? मॉनिटर का इनपुट ग़लत है
scenes.image_brief: A desktop tower with a bright blue power light glowing under a desk while the monitor above it stays completely black and reflects the dim room, evening light.

scenes.narration: Press the monitor's source button until your desktop suddenly appears.
scenes.caption: मॉनिटर का सोर्स बटन दबाते रहें जब तक डेस्कटॉप न दिखे
scenes.image_brief: A monitor's edge buttons beside an on-screen input menu listing several video inputs with one highlighted, the desktop wallpaper appearing behind the menu, cool screen light.

scenes.narration: A burnt smell or a scorch mark on the case means stop.
scenes.caption: जलने की गंध या केस पर झुलसा निशान दिखे तो रुक जाएँ
scenes.image_brief: A close view of a desktop tower's rear power supply grille with a brown scorch ring around one vent and a faint wisp of smoke above it, harsh direct light.

scenes.narration: Never open a power supply. Those capacitors hold a charge.
scenes.caption: पावर सप्लाई कभी न खोलें। उसके कैपेसिटर चार्ज रखते हैं
scenes.image_brief: A sealed power supply unit resting on a workbench with a warning label across its casing and its screws untouched, a screwdriver set aside out of reach, flat cool light.

scenes.narration: Check the monitor cable sits in the graphics card, not the motherboard.
scenes.caption: जाँचें कि मॉनिटर केबल ग्राफ़िक्स कार्ड में लगी है, मदरबोर्ड में नहीं
scenes.image_brief: The rear of a desktop tower with a video cable plugged into the lower graphics card port and the unused motherboard video port sitting empty just above it, bright torch light on both ports.

title: 💀 Arjun's blue screen loop... the one thing to read before restarting #bluescreen #pcfix
title_alts: 🧰 Arjun rolls back one driver in safe mode with networking #bluescreen #pcfix
🚫 Arjun keeps restarting and loses the blue screen stop code #bluescreen #pcfix
description_hook: A blue screen that returns every time you restart is usually one driver, not a dying computer. The stop code tells you which.
problem_domain: repeating blue screen crashes after a driver change
setting: a bedroom desk with two monitors at night
protagonist_type: a gamer who installed something new last night

characters.name: Arjun
characters.description: nineteen, buzz cut, oversized black hoodie, a cracked phone case he uses as a camera stand

claims.claim: Cut the power during boot three times
claims.basis: round illustrative repeat count for triggering recovery, stated as a rough instruction

claims.claim: Two clean boots in a row
claims.basis: round illustrative confirmation threshold, stated as a rough check rather than a measurement

scenes.narration: Blue screen, restart, blue screen again. The same loop.
scenes.caption: नीली स्क्रीन, रीस्टार्ट, फिर नीली स्क्रीन। वही चक्र
scenes.image_brief: A monitor filling the frame with a plain blue error screen showing a stalled progress percentage and a stop code line, the dark bedroom behind lit only by the screen.

scenes.narration: A driver that does not match your hardware can crash the whole system.
scenes.caption: हार्डवेयर से मेल न खाता ड्राइवर पूरा सिस्टम गिरा सकता है
scenes.image_brief: A close view of a graphics card seated in a motherboard slot with a driver installer window glowing on the monitor behind it, cool light on the card's metal shroud.

scenes.narration: Windows restarts, loads that same driver, and falls over again.
scenes.caption: विंडोज़ फिर चलता है, वही ड्राइवर लोड करता है, फिर गिर जाता है
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing the same blue error screen mirrored faintly in a second dark monitor beside it, a keyboard between them on the desk, dim night light.

scenes.narration: You need the crash to pause long enough to click a few things.
scenes.caption: क्रैश को इतनी देर रोकना है कि दो-चार क्लिक हो सकें
scenes.image_brief: A desk with a monitor showing a spinning boot circle and an open notebook with a pen resting on it beside the keyboard, low lamp light from one side.

scenes.narration: Cut the power during boot three times to force recovery mode.
scenes.caption: बूट के दौरान तीन बार बिजली काटें, रिकवरी मोड खुल जागा
scenes.image_brief: A desktop tower under a desk with its power lead running to a wall switch that has just been flicked off, the monitor above showing a half-drawn boot logo, dim room.

scenes.narration: Choose startup settings, then pick safe mode with networking enabled.
scenes.caption: स्टार्टअप सेटिंग्स चुनें, फिर नेटवर्किंग वाला सेफ़ मोड लें
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a startup settings list on a plain background with the safe mode with networking line highlighted, the dark desk lit only by the screen.

scenes.narration: Open device manager. Find the part you changed most recently.
scenes.caption: डिवाइस मैनेजर खोलें। सबसे हाल में बदला हिस्सा ढूँढें
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a device manager tree with a display adapter entry carrying a small yellow warning triangle, that entry highlighted blue, cool screen light in a dim room.

scenes.narration: Roll back that driver to the older one, then restart normally.
scenes.caption: उस ड्राइवर को पुराने वाले पर लौटाएँ, फिर सामान्य रीस्टार्ट करें
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a driver properties window with an active roll back driver button and a small confirmation box over it, a mug beside the keyboard, dim room light.

scenes.narration: Two clean boots in a row means the driver was the culprit.
scenes.caption: लगातार दो साफ़ बूट का मतलब ड्राइवर ही दोषी था
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a clean desktop wallpaper after a normal start, the tower's steady power light visible under the desk, soft morning light through a window.

scenes.narration: Check the reliability history for a quiet stretch with no fresh errors.
scenes.caption: रिलायबिलिटी हिस्ट्री में बिना नई त्रुटि वाला शांत दौर देखें
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a reliability history chart with a long unbroken row of clear days and no red error markers, cool screen glow in a tidy room.

scenes.narration: Different stop codes every crash? That points at failing memory.
scenes.caption: हर बार अलग स्टॉप कोड? इशारा खराब मेमोरी की तरफ़ है
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a blue error screen with a different stop code than before, and a sticky note stuck to the bezel listing three different codes in pen, dim light.

scenes.narration: Run a memory test overnight before you buy any new parts.
scenes.caption: नए पुर्ज़े ख़रीदने से पहले रातभर मेमोरी टेस्ट चलाएँ
scenes.image_brief: A monitor in a dark room showing a memory test screen with a pass counter and a progress bar, the open computer case standing beside the desk with two memory sticks visible inside.

scenes.narration: Photograph the stop code before you restart. It names the guilty file.
scenes.caption: रीस्टार्ट से पहले स्टॉप कोड की फ़ोटो लें। वह फ़ाइल बताता है
scenes.image_brief: A phone propped against a keyboard with its camera aimed at a monitor showing a blue error screen, the stop code line sharp and readable, the room lit only by the screen.

title: 😫 Neha's low disk space warning... the folder that refills it? #diskspace #pctips
title_alts: 🧹 Neha clears old update files with disk cleanup, step by step #diskspace #pctips
🚫 Neha nearly deleted the Program Files folder to free disk space #diskspace #pctips
description_hook: A full drive stops you saving anything, and deleting the wrong thing makes it worse. Here is the order that actually frees room.
problem_domain: a drive with no free space left
setting: a shared family laptop on a kitchen counter
protagonist_type: a student whose coursework will not save

characters.name: Neha
characters.description: twenty-two, dark bob with a blunt fringe, mustard yellow jumper, a lanyard of USB sticks round her neck

claims.basis: round illustrative threshold, stated loosely rather than as a specification
round illustrative headroom target, stated as a rule of thumb
round illustrative time for a glance at the drive properties, stated as such

scenes.narration: A red bar on your drive, and nothing will save.
scenes.caption: ड्राइव पर लाल पट्टी, और कुछ भी सेव नहीं हो रहा
scenes.image_brief: A file manager window on a laptop screen showing a drive bar filled solid red with only a sliver of grey left, a failed save dialog box open over it, cool screen light in a dim kitchen.

scenes.narration: Windows needs spare room for updates, swap files, and its own temporary work.
scenes.caption: विंडोज़ को अपडेट, स्वैप और अस्थायी काम के लिए जगह चाहिए
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing a storage breakdown list with large blocks for updates, temporary files and a page file, and the smallest slice left for free space, cool screen glow.

scenes.narration: Below a couple of gigabytes it simply stops letting you work properly.
scenes.caption: दो-तीन गीगाबाइट से नीचे वह काम करने ही नहीं देता
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing a storage warning banner about insufficient space with a greyed-out save button behind it, the room dark except for the screen.

scenes.narration: Empty the recycle bin first. Deleted files still sit in there.
scenes.caption: पहले रीसायकल बिन ख़ाली करें। मिटाई फ़ाइलें वहीं पड़ी रहती हैं
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing an open recycle bin window crowded with file icons and an empty recycle bin button along the top, warm desk lamp light across the keyboard edge.

scenes.narration: Sort downloads by size. Then delete the installers you already ran.
scenes.caption: डाउनलोड आकार से छाँटें। फिर चले हुए इंस्टॉलर हटा दें
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing a downloads folder sorted by size with several very large installer files at the top of the list highlighted together, cool screen light.

scenes.narration: Run disk cleanup, and tick the box for old update files.
scenes.caption: डिस्क क्लीनअप चलाएँ और पुरानी अपडेट फ़ाइलों का बॉक्स चुनें
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing a disk cleanup window with a checklist of file categories, the old update files line ticked, and a recovered space figure beside it, dim room.

scenes.narration: Move photos and video onto an external drive, not another folder.
scenes.caption: फ़ोटो और वीडियो बाहरी ड्राइव में ले जाएँ, दूसरे फ़ोल्डर में नहीं
scenes.image_brief: A small external hard drive on a kitchen counter joined by cable to a laptop, a window of photo thumbnails copying across on the screen, soft afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Aim for fifteen percent free. Then the red bar turns grey again.
scenes.caption: पंद्रह प्रतिशत जगह ख़ाली रखें। फिर लाल पट्टी धूसर हो जाती है
scenes.image_brief: A file manager window showing the same drive bar now mostly grey with a wide free section and no red left, cool even screen light.

scenes.narration: A drive that refills every week? Something is quietly syncing into it.
scenes.caption: हर हफ़्ते ड्राइव भर जाती है? वहाँ कुछ चुपचाप सिंक हो रहा है
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing a cloud sync folder filling with duplicate copies of files and a spinning sync icon in the corner, a full drive bar beneath it, dim evening light.

scenes.narration: Never delete files from the Windows or Program Files folders yourself.
scenes.caption: विंडोज़ या प्रोग्राम फ़ाइल्स फ़ोल्डर से ख़ुद कुछ न मिटाएँ
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing the Windows and Program Files system folders in a file manager with a warning dialog blocking a delete, cool screen light in a dark room.

scenes.narration: Check your free space on the first of every month. Just ten seconds.
scenes.caption: हर महीने की पहली तारीख़ को ख़ाली जगह देखें। दस सेकंड
scenes.image_brief: A wall calendar beside a kitchen counter with a small handwritten note on the first of the month reading check free space, the closed laptop on the counter below, morning light.

title: 😨 Rohan's USB drive will not show up... read this before formatting #usbfix #pctips
title_alts: 🔤 Rohan assigns a drive letter in disk management to a hidden stick #usbfix #pctips
🚫 Rohan nearly formatted a USB stick with all his photos on it #usbfix #pctips
description_hook: A USB stick that never appears is often only missing a drive letter. Formatting it would have cost every file on board.
problem_domain: removable storage that the computer will not display
setting: a college library desk with a borrowed desktop
protagonist_type: someone carrying the only copy of a file

characters.name: Rohan
characters.description: thirty, thick black-framed glasses, grey zip-up fleece, a red keyring lanyard on his USB stick

scenes.narration: You plug in the USB stick. Nothing opens.
scenes.caption: आप USB स्टिक लगाते हैं। कुछ भी नहीं खुलता
scenes.image_brief: A silver USB stick with a red keyring lanyard pushed into the side port of a computer, its tiny indicator light on, the screen behind showing an empty file explorer window, cool daylight.

scenes.narration: A drive with no drive letter assigned stays invisible in file explorer.
scenes.caption: जिस ड्राइव को लेटर नहीं मिला, वह फ़ाइल एक्सप्लोरर में नहीं दिखती
scenes.image_brief: A screen showing a file explorer sidebar that lists only the main hard drive and no removable drive entry, the plugged-in USB stick visible at the edge of the frame, cool screen light.

scenes.narration: It is powered up and spinning, but it has no name to click.
scenes.caption: वह चालू है और घूम रही है, पर क्लिक करने को नाम नहीं
scenes.image_brief: A close view of a USB stick's exposed circuit board with a small green power light glowing on it, resting beside its plastic cap on a wooden library desk, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Try a different port first, ideally one on the back of the machine.
scenes.caption: पहले दूसरा पोर्ट आज़माएँ, बेहतर हो मशीन के पीछे का
scenes.image_brief: The back panel of a desktop tower with a row of USB ports, one stick seated in a port directly on the motherboard block, bright torch light across the panel.

scenes.narration: Open disk management. Look for a bar with a size but no letter.
scenes.caption: डिस्क मैनेजमेंट खोलें। ऐसी पट्टी देखें जिसमें आकार हो पर लेटर नहीं
scenes.image_brief: A screen showing a disk management window with a lower panel of partition bars, one bar labelled with a size but carrying no drive letter, cool screen glow in a dim room.

scenes.narration: Right click that partition, choose change drive letter, and assign a free one.
scenes.caption: उस पार्टिशन पर राइट क्लिक करके कोई ख़ाली लेटर दे दें
scenes.image_brief: A screen showing a change drive letter dialog open over the disk management window with a dropdown list of unused letters showing, cool screen light.

scenes.narration: If it says unallocated, stop. Your files are still sitting down there.
scenes.caption: अगर लिखा है अनॉलोकेटेड, तो रुकें। आपकी फ़ाइलें अब भी वहीं हैं
scenes.image_brief: A screen showing a disk management partition bar marked unallocated with diagonal hatching across it, the pointer resting well away from the delete options, dim room light.

scenes.narration: The drive opens with your folders intact, and the capacity looks right.
scenes.caption: ड्राइव खुलती है, फ़ोल्डर सही हैं और क्षमता भी ठीक दिखती है
scenes.image_brief: A screen showing an opened removable drive window full of folder icons with the capacity line readable along the bottom, the USB stick plugged in at the frame's edge, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: A stick that clicks or grows hot is dying. Unplug it now.
scenes.caption: जो स्टिक खटकती या गरम होती है, वह मर रही है। तुरंत निकालें
scenes.image_brief: A USB stick lying alone on a library desk with a scratched, discoloured metal shell and faint heat haze above it, a computer with an empty port behind, harsh overhead light.

scenes.narration: Do not format anything you want back. Formatting is not repair.
scenes.caption: जो वापस चाहिए उसे फ़ॉर्मेट न करें। फ़ॉर्मेट मरम्मत नहीं है
scenes.image_brief: A screen showing a format dialog box for a removable drive with its start button untouched and a warning line about erasing all data, cool screen light in a dark room.

scenes.narration: Copy anything irreplaceable off it today, before you test anything further.
scenes.caption: जो अनमोल है वह आज ही कॉपी कर लें, आगे जाँच बाद में
scenes.image_brief: An external hard drive beside a computer on a library desk with a file copy window on the screen moving photos off a removable drive, the USB stick plugged in nearby, warm morning light.
